changed_behaviour: Importing a passkey credential without a user handle, or with no resulting credentials, is now rejected with 400 instead of storing a non-functional credential.
rationale: Schema lists user_handle but never requires it nor mentions a 400 for missing handle on passkey import.

changed_behaviour: GET flag snapshots now applies a configured default limit when no limit parameter is supplied.
rationale: No contract document exists at parent commit.

changed_behaviour: Iceberg schema with a field id equal to the initial column id (0) is no longer rejected as a duplicate field ID.
rationale: Contract paths are empty (inferred from annotations); internal helper, HTTP operation not determinable.

changed_behaviour: Consumer instance deletion and stale-consumer cleanup now manage timestamp bookkeeping consistently; no clear HTTP-visible change beyond thread safety.
rationale: Mostly concurrency refactor; only internal map cleanup moved. Unclear observable effect.

changed_behaviour: Updating a process now prefills the config from the existing process so omitted fields keep current values (partial update), and returns 404 when the process does not exist.
rationale: Contract says only 'Replace an existing process'; partial-merge semantics and 404 are not stated for PUT.

changed_behaviour: Azure AD SSO credential now derives user name, roles and token refresh from MSAL4J account (username/homeAccountId) instead of ADAL display id/unique id.
rationale: SSO login flow is not described in the user OpenAPI paths; endpoint not identifiable.

changed_behaviour: Page number below 1 is now clamped to 1 and negative page size to 0 instead of throwing an assertion error.
rationale: Only generator config files present; no usable OpenAPI document.

changed_behaviour: Listing commits with a non-existent sha now returns 404 instead of 500.
rationale: No checked-in contract document at parent commit.

changed_behaviour: Implicit subscription of a user to an entity now happens even if the user already has an inherited subscription from a parent.
rationale: Triggering operations unclear; contract only mentions inherited subscriptions for DELETE, not implicit subscribing.

changed_behaviour: Creating a payment with a non-HTTPS return_url on a live account now returns 422 with code P0920 and message 'Must begin with https://'.
spec_quote: An HTTPS URL on your site that your user will be sent back to once they have completed their payment attempt on GOV.UK Pay.
rationale: Description of return_url says HTTPS URL; 422 exists for create. Specific live-account rule and P0920 code not stated.

changed_behaviour: Service operation bindings gain a routingKey property in the model.
rationale: Binding schema lists type, keyType, destinationName etc. but no routingKey.

changed_behaviour: Shell and submodel descriptor endpoints now carry computed interface names, per-id hrefs, configurable callback address and subprotocol fields.
rationale: No contract document exists; affected descriptor operations not clearly identified.

changed_behaviour: Recent time series query by ts-ids now also scopes lookup by the supplied office.
rationale: No contract document at parent commit; path inferred from controller name.

changed_behaviour: Snapshot import now returns 400 for empty file, 415 for non-JSON content type, 500 on import failure, and 201 only on success (previously always 201).
rationale: Contract lists only 201; no 400, 415 or 500 responses documented.

changed_behaviour: Stopping scan-all now sets a stop mark so the running scan-all loop terminates and stops launching scans, rather than only stopping the execution.
rationale: Operation described as stopping the scanAll execution; change makes that stop effective. Detailed mechanism not specified.
